changes.evidence: Whitney is a contract actress at the film studio Anvil Studios (she is shooting on set and in her dressing room from the S2 premiere; the studio is named in 'Smoke & Mirrors', S2E4, where her director Kenneth tells her the studio wanted to recast her). After she takes over the Council of Nine, she holds a press conference outside Anvil Studios in 'Monsters' (S2E7) and announces she is retiring from acting. So the employer stage is missing. It starts at S2 and ends inside S2, and the Council of Nine stays her last stage.

owner_calls.question: Connors runs a drug operation with the dealer Duane Porter and Porter's 'errand boys' (Kev). He takes seized drugs out of the NOPD evidence room to sell them. The crew is never named on screen. Add it next to NOPD?
options: Keep [["NOPD", "(from the start)"]] (the crew is unnamed)
Add the drug crew under a name the owner chooses, from the start, alongside NOPD (NOPD stays his last stage)
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki, 'All Vice, No Virtue' and 'Danger Coming' sections (Cloak & Dagger S1 episodes 1-3): 'involved in New Orleans' drug trade together with Duane Porter'. In 'Funhouse Mirrors' Connors scolds Porter: 'Your little errand boys got all sloppy!'
